entities.summary: Toi8 (b. 1976-10-08, Kumamoto Prefecture) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kumamoto Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
